Want to experience the nano-texture feel of an iPad screen but don't want to make a long-term commitment? Astropad has launched a brand-new version of Rock Paper Pencil, retaining the detachable design while adding a second writing feel.

Apple Pencil paired with iPad can now deliver a realistic pencil feel—the all-new Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 is officially here

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 combines a nano-texture screen protector with a specialised Apple Pencil tip. For the first time, buyers can choose between two options: the smooth feel of a ballpoint pen, or the soft high-friction resistance of graphite.

The new graphite tip mimics the feel of a 2B pencil, adding extra friction to meet artists' needs in sketching, shading and stroke expression.

Astropad said that developing this new option took about a year, with a standard 2B pencil used as the reference benchmark. The company also noted that the finished product reproduces the visual and sound effects of real graphite.

Ballpoint pen or standard pencil feel—your choice

The original steel ballpoint tip is retained, suitable for writing, line outlining, fine-line drawing and neat note-taking. Each Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 set now comes with four Apple Pencil tips: two ballpoint tips and two graphite tips.

The screen protector itself remains unchanged. Astropad's patented NanoCling system uses electrostatic adhesion instead of adhesive, so it can be applied, removed and reused at any time without leaving any residue.

The company says this adhesion is stronger than magnets, while supporting bubble-free application and easy removal. The protector's fine texture mimics the feel of fine-grain paper, providing friction and better control.

The best matte screen protector for iPad

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 is more than just swapping an Apple Pencil tip or changing the screen texture—it treats the two as a complete system. Astropad says the specialised tips are designed specifically for the nano-texture protector. The new graphite tip is made of POM, while the ballpoint tip is steel.

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 is now on sale at US$49.99 with free worldwide shipping. The 3.0 version is also available simultaneously, while stocks last, with discount offers.
